purpose: Determine whether crossover probability and score weight create repeatable differences in validation performance under the existing inner search.
data_policy: Reuse frozen training/validation split only. No final scoring or final-score-guided selection. Final features and labels unavailable to new candidates.

inner_search.model_profile: Unchanged K3: reasoning_effort low, max_output_tokens8192, temperature1, top_p0.95, streaming, transport retries0

schedule.rule: Each repetition is a block containing each of nine configurations exactly once; order independently shuffled from a frozen schedule seed.
schedule.inner_seed_rule: SHA256 domain calibration-repeatability.v1|spambase|repeat_index, first32bits; same inner seed across configurations within repetition; no model-output determinism claimed.

primary_measurement: Best trusted validation accuracy from each independent inner search; retain null outcomes, completion counts, all request/token costs and operator traces.

summaries: configuration means and repeat standard deviations
paired differences from the center configuration
nine-configuration rank agreement across repetition blocks
analysis.variance_model: Complete balanced matrix: additive configuration plus repetition-block model. Residual mean square estimates within-design noise; configuration variance estimate=max(0,(MS_configuration-MS_residual)/repeats).
analysis.stability_gate: Exploratory diagnostic flag only: complete matrix, estimated configuration ICC>=0.5, and median pairwise Spearman rank correlation across blocks>=0.5. Tied ranks use averages; constant ranks provide no evidence. No hypothesis-test or algorithm superiority claim.
analysis.incomplete_matrix: No stable-signal verdict; report observed data and stop reasons without reruns or imputation.
analysis.confirmation: Any subsequent algorithm superiority claim requires a separately frozen protocol and untouched confirmation evaluation. This diagnostic does not produce a new final-test result.
